Closes #759

## What landed

- **Row 1:** `greptile-apps[bot]` is removed from `connected_reviewers` in `.tradecraft/work.json`. Nothing else in that file changed, and `greptile.json` is unchanged. CodeRabbit and Codex remain the connected reviewers.

## Proof

- **Floor.** Run by the builder through `run floor` at `4f12aa5`: lint 0 findings, 1,140 passed, 1 skipped ([floor](https://github.com/Grimblaz-and-Friends/tradecraft/pull/767#issuecomment-5852487982)). CI `lint-and-test` passes on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest at that head.
- **Builder.** Codex `gpt-5.6-sol` at `xhigh` through `run build`, session [recorded on #759](https://github.com/Grimblaz-and-Friends/tradecraft/issues/759#issuecomment-5852421302).
- **Connected reviewers at `4f12aa5`.** CodeRabbit generated no actionable comments. Codex completed its review with no comments. Greptile posted a real review (confidence 5/5, no inline comments), not its credit-limit notice. The gate credits all three.
- **Required gate: red at `4f12aa5`**, for one reason only: `missing: a current-head generated no-use record matching trusted policy`, because the record carries a `source`. It verified the floor, the proof identity and all three reviewers.

**Path departures:** the required gate is bypassed, red at `4f12aa5`. The owner affirmed the mechanical lane, so `run proof` writes a generated no-use record whose `source` is the affirmed brief comment. The shared gate accepts a generated no-use record only when `source` is null (`proof/check.py` at `cb5b746`, the `valid_generated` test), so it rejects this record. This change's only path, `.tradecraft/work.json`, matches none of the gate's use rules, so the change buys no use by either the paths or the lane. The red is the record's shape, not a missing use. change-proof #21 covers the lane for paths that do buy a use, and this is the case where they buy none. There was no artifact, cold seat or use, because the mechanical lane exempts all three. The gate reads the base branch's configuration, which still lists Greptile, so it still expected, and credited, a Greptile record. Two earlier gate reruns failed on the holder's sequencing (tradecraft #765's shape): one ran while the pull request was a draft, and one found no `Path departures` paragraph and floor checks from a replaced CI run. Merging over the red gate is the owner's decision.
